title: Make checkpoint restore atomic and destination-safe
description: Review finding from loreweaver-niw. Checkpoint restore materialization is not transactional and assumes a new/empty destination DB, so a failure can leave a partial destination file. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Restore rejects unsafe existing destinations or restores into a temp DB then atomically renames; injected restore failures leave no partial usable destination; tests cover failure cleanup.
